title: Republicans Let Trump Keep Unparalleled Benefit: I.R.S. Immunity
summary: The rebellion against Todd Blanche’s nomination to be attorney general, now seemingly contained, at no point fundamentally questioned President Trump’s new protections from the I.R.S.
